eyebrow.zh: 实时语音 · 插话感知 · 开源
eyebrow.en: Real-time voice · Barge-in aware · Open source

headline.zh: 用户中途插话，助手让出话轮；用户说完，从被打断处续接——不抢话，不重头开始
headline.en: When the user interrupts, the agent lets them speak; once they finish, it continues from the interrupted point — no talking over, no restart

sub.zh: 插话的瞬间，它记下助手说到哪个字、做到哪一步；用户说完，就从这个点继续——而非丢掉整轮重来。
sub.en: The moment the user cuts in, it remembers exactly how far the agent got — word and step — then resumes from that point once they finish, instead of scrapping the whole turn.

body.zh: 用户中途插话时，助手让出话轮并保存进度；等用户说完，从被打断的那个字接着往下说——不再把已经讲过的话从头复述一遍。
body.en: When the user cuts in mid-sentence, the agent steps aside and saves its place; once they finish, it picks up from the exact interrupted word — instead of re-stating everything from the top.

chips: › Picks up at the exact word

body.zh: 不只是文本演示——续接接到了真实语音助手自身的插话事件：检测到你和助手同时说话就暂停，你一说完就续接。还能按单句话、按单次工具调用决定是否允许打断。
body.en: Not a text-only demo — continuation is wired to a real voice agent's own interrupt events: the moment your speech overlaps the agent's, it pauses; the moment you finish, it resumes. You can also allow or block interruptions per utterance and per tool call.

chips: › Pauses when you talk over it

body.zh: 每一次让出与续接都落成一条持久记录，跨重启不丢、可查询；排障和合规审计都能回溯某一轮被插话时助手说到哪、做到哪一步。
body.en: Every yield and resume becomes a durable record that survives restarts and stays queryable — so for debugging or compliance you can trace exactly where an interrupted turn was, word and step.

headline.zh: 给你的语音助手，加上被打断也能续接的能力
headline.en: Give your voice agent the ability to continue after an interrupt

sub.zh: 一条命令，本地并排对比：从被打断处续接 vs 从头重来。
sub.en: One command, locally, side by side: continue from the interrupt vs a fresh restart.
